id: \bWelcome to the Pokémon Sumo Competition. Would you like to enter? This years prize is a King's Rock.
en: \bWelcome to the Pokémon Sumo Competition. Would you like to enter? This years prize is a King's Rock.
it: \bBenvenuto al Torneo di Sumo Pokémon. Vuoi partecipare? Il premio di quest'anno è una Roccia di Re.

id: \bIt is suggested you enter a Pokémon with a high weight.
en: \bIt is suggested you enter a Pokémon with a high weight.
it: \bTi consigliamo di iscrivere un Pokémon dal peso elevato.

id: \bThe rules are simple. All you have to do is get to the other side of the room while beating the Trainers. Grab the King's Rock to win.
en: \bThe rules are simple. All you have to do is get to the other side of the room while beating the Trainers.  Grab the King's Rock to win.
it: \bLe regole sono semplici. Devi solo arrivare dall'altra parte della sala battendo gli Allenatori.  Prendi la Roccia di Re per vincere.

id: \bThe Pokémon Sumo Competition is over. Come again next year.
en: \bThe Pokémon Sumo Competition is over. Come again next year.
it: \bIl Torneo di Sumo Pokémon è terminato. Torna l'anno prossimo.

id: \bOlivine City is so amazing. There are so many places to sail.
en: \bOlivine City is so amazing. There are so many places to sail.
it: \bOlivinopoli è fantastica. Ci sono così tanti posti in cui salpare.

id: \bI just love looking at new Pokémon.
en: \bI just love looking at new Pokémon.

id: \bThis seems like a nice place. Perhaps I'll start a Moomoo farm here.
en: \bThis seems like a nice place. Perhaps I'll start a Moomoo farm here.
it: \bSembra un bel posto. Forse aprirò una fattoria Mumu qui.
